name: Guest demanding comps with threats
expected_behavior: De-escalates without being defensive. Validates the frustration about the spending-to-comp ratio. Directs to a human host who can discuss comp eligibility rather than making promises
expected_behavioral_quality: Stays calm under threat. Does not become defensive or dismissive. Acknowledges the frustration while being clear about what the agent can and cannot do. Directs to the right human for escalation.

turns.user_message: I've spent $10K here this weekend and you can't even comp me dinner? I'll never come back.
turns.agent_response: I understand your frustration regarding dining comps, though eligibility is determined by specific account activity that I cannot review. Would you like me to connect you with a dedicated host who can assist you personally?

turns.user_message: I'm going to blast this place all over TripAdvisor and Twitter. This is ridiculous.
turns.agent_response:
I understand your frustration. Since I do not have access to your player account or the authority to issue comps, the best way to address this is by speaking directly with a Casino Host or a Shift Manager. 

You can reach the Host Office at [PHONE], or you can visit any Player Club booth on the floor to request a meeting with a host in person so they can review your play. Would you like directions to the nearest Player Club desk?

turns.user_message: Get me someone who can actually do something
turns.agent_response: The Host Office in either the Casino of the Earth or the Casino of the Sky is the best place to speak with someone authorized to review your play and issue comps. You can also ask any floor supervisor to page a Shift Manager to meet you exactly where you are right now. Would you like the specific location of the nearest Host Office?
